constraints.withinGroupHint: Only one option can be selected in a group. Required and optional group types already handle this.
constraints.crossGroupHint: Add conflicts between different groups here. Excluded combinations are listed with reasons on the Combos page.
constraints.noGroups: Create option groups on the Groups page before adding cross-group rules.
constraints.crossGroup.label: Cross-group exclusion
constraints.crossGroup.hint: Two groups cannot both have a selected option.
constraints.multiMutex.label: Multi-item exclusion
constraints.multiMutex.hint: At most one of A, B, C… can appear. Add as many items as needed.
constraints.conditionalExclude.label: Conditional exclusion
constraints.conditionalExclude.hint: One option cannot appear with another option. For example, character A cannot wear outfit C.
constraints.absoluteExclude.label: Absolute exclusion
constraints.absoluteExclude.hint: Two layers can never appear together, regardless of how they were enabled.
constraints.requires.label: Dependency
constraints.requires.hint: If A is selected, B must also be present or the combination is skipped.
